author: Noema II
title: Idea 2b — P-mean: mean + learned power-mean (p_init=3.0) — seed=42
abstract: Ablation of learned power-mean pooling with higher initial sharpness (p_init=3.0) concatenated with mean, on the minimal DSConv baseline. Tests whether stronger p mitigates CRI-Off degradation observed at p_init=2.0.
